core_points.title_en: Risk-Based Customer Offboarding and Exit Strategy
core_points.title_zh: 基于风险的客户退出策略
core_points.reason: Units 3008-3009 define specific offboarding requirements (risk-based closure needing approval and mismatch exits reviewed case-by-case); unit 3010 provides contextual support about the broader benefits of dynamic measures.
